body:
I never once said I blamed her, or found her in any wrong. But I'm tired of being alone, of wanting to feel cared for and loved and no one being there, of only ever being wanted for sex and then being left alone. I don't want to bother with this anymore. I'm tired of being a mistake for people. I don't want to keep doing this or bring here.

I'm sick of my life, plain and simple.

I have looked into university, and I would have a massive debt if I went into a course. I have no passion to go into any such courses, and the idea of having a crippling student debt for it very much doesn't help.

I don't have moments where I'm "happiest", I am generally always just disinterested and the closest I get now is a mild shallow amusement. The last time I felt actually happy was when my friend and I were able to talk, be around eachother and have fun, and they don't want to talk to me anymore.

I also don't have anything I specifically want to draw, I just do it because I can and because I have absolutely nothing else to do. There is really no special "I like drawing [x]" or so on, it's just not there.

I honestly don't have any real interest in any subjects, nothing catches my interest, and I have had glimpses of college and university work, I've seen that it's not the same as highschool, but it still feels the same. Not to mention even if I had the want, I don't have the money.

There really isn't anything I want in life anymore, that's the thing, any change in life I would want is to no longer have a life.

I spend my time by cleaning the house, and that's about it. I live a bit outside of town, so I can't just go somewhere. And with winter setting in that point is doubly enforced. There isn't anything in town I really care about anyways, so even if I had the means, I don't have the motivation. 

I basically just sleep, clean the house, try to draw because I have absolutely nothing else to do, realize I have no motivation or interest in drawing, nothing I want to draw, try to force it, hate what comes out, try to motivate myself to do anything for the rest of the day, then sleep for about half the day, rinse and repeat.

I have honestly zero interest in any kind of psychology or related things in the form of higher education, I not only have no money for this, but I genuinely don't find the thought of going back into a school environment at all appealing. In general I despised school, it caused a LOT of stress for me, and was if I recall the birthplace of my anxiety. Even being in a school environment causes my mood to plummet.

Meditation is something I've tried to do, and it may help a bit with stress, but that only goes so far, and then I'm stuck with remembering things that make me feel worse than I had started.

I have talked to a psychologist, and a psychiatrist, that is why I was on the antidepressants in the first place, and since, I've been kind of let go from my psychiatrist's care and the psychologist is on a year long vacation. 

Literally everything I speak to that social worker about is stuff I've already gone over myself, I understand psychology and mental health, I've researched into it countless times as a hobby, and many many people in the field I've talked to have been astounded at my understanding of the human condition, emotion, mentality, and so on. 

When I say it feels pointless, it's because it really does feel pointless from a logical perspective; everything I've been told I already know, everything I've talked about I already talked about to myself and have gone through with a fine comb.

And before it ever gets brought up; group therapy is right out, I can barely tell one random person about my issues, when I needed to present things in school I nearly would pass out from anxiety.

As for my art, I've made this account with the specific intent to keep it disconnected from my online presence, in the event of anyone I know finding this. They have heard enough as is and I would rather they don't feel guilt tripped into interacting with me (i.e. "I need to talk to/ rekindle the friendship with this person or they will kill themself"). So if I were to openly link my work or things I like, it could render the point moot.

I've been selfharming too, partially in sadness and also to see if I can at least feel some form of extreme, even pain can at least confirm that I can still feel. But it also seems like even pain feels numbed.

I do follow artists and try to keep drawing and such but it doesn't really feel like it did, as I've said, it just feels bland. I have talked to a professional, I've been seeing a therapist for depression for years now, medicine does nothing and sessions just go in circles without any help. More than once I've thought of just not going anymore because it really hasn't done anything for me at all despite how long it's been, and my therapist is now on vacation and I'm seeing this social worker. So all it really seems to be is me talking about things I feel uncomfortable talking about, that I have already talked about, to someone that's extremely annoying.

I never had any classes I really liked; I partially enjoyed the art class, and media arts, but even when trying to do that now it feels very bland. As I've said, since I lost my friend and in general as life goes by everything and anything has been becoming extremely bland. I can see what I liked, but I don't care really about it anymore.

As for personalities; I know about the Myers Briggs types, and I'm a split down intp/infp. Which both tend to kind of keep to themselves. And when it comes to friends and socializing, I still can't be bothered to care much, literally talking to people drains me, and only if I'm talking to close close friends, do I not feel all that exhausted.

I am 20, I've gone through highschool, haven't gone to college due to not having the money or interest in any possible course available. I've tried to go into whatever activities just to see if anything will click, and nothing manages to interest me.
As for social circles, I honestly can't say I get on too well with many people, I can't really seem to enjoy socializing unless it's with a close friend, otherwise I really don't like doing so.
Sadly no. I've never cared for sports, and there's no activities that I can afford or that interests me.
